result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Gusto is my top recommendation for payroll software in 2026** if you're operating in the United States. It combines payroll processing, tax calculations, automatic tax filing, employee benefits, and basic HR tools in one easy-to-use platform.

However, the best option depends on your business size, location, and whether you have employees or independent contractors.

## Important: If your business is in Canada

The recommendations above are primarily US-focused. If you're running a Canadian business, I would look at Canadian payroll providers instead.

My Canadian shortlist would include\:

- **Wagepoint** – Designed for Canadian small businesses, with payroll tax remittances and T4 support.
- **PaymentEvolution** – Canadian payroll processing, direct deposit, and tax filing options.
- **QuickBooks Payroll** – Worth considering if you already use QuickBooks, but check Canadian product availability and features.
- **ADP Canada** – A good option if you need more comprehensive payroll and HR services.

Wagepoint's official pricing currently starts at \$20 CAD/month plus \$4 per employee for one monthly payroll run, or \$40 plus \$6 per employee for unlimited runs. [www.wagepoint.com](https://www.wagepoint.com/pricing/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.agendrix.com](https://www.agendrix.com/blog/best-payroll-software-for-small-business-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**My recommendation\:** Start by comparing Wagepoint and QuickBooks Payroll if you're in Canada.

search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
